0.content: Chongyun's best friend is the bookish swordsman Xingqiu, younger son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Xingqiu suggested he hunt for a spirit immune to yang energy. Chongyun took the idea to heart, and Xingqiu has fed him "leads" ever since: the legendary Aoyin near the Sea of Clouds, an evil spirit in an old house at Feiyun Slope, a master exorcist at Wangshu Inn. Most are invented. When Chongyun comes back empty-handed and out of pocket, Xingqiu cheers him up, treats him to new cold dishes and quietly goes to get his swindled money back. Chongyun thinks of him as warm and reliable while warning others that Xingqiu "definitely has a mean side".

1.content: Chongyun's condition, said to occur once every thousand generations or so, is an overabundance of yang (positive) energy. Evil spirits flee for miles around him, so he can exorcise a haunting simply by sitting in the room. It also overheats his body and temper: sun, hot or spicy food, thick clothes, arguments, rousing music and strong emotions push him toward outbursts. To manage it he eats only cold food, drinks iced Qingxin water, wears light clothing, carries a parasol, avoids quarrels and keeps popsicles on hand. Nothing has cured it.

2.content: Chongyun's popsicles are made for him at Wanmin Restaurant from water, Mist Flower and Qingxin. They have no particular flavor but calm his yang energy, and he must carry some at all times. In his Hangout Event he gave his last ones to a hungry boy, Dalong, and went with the Traveler to restock. A sweet fruit version tasted wonderful but worked less well; a Jueyun Chili and Slime Condensate "fight fire with fire" version set his throat on fire and ended the outing.

3.comment: Chongyun: Signs of Evil (Chongyun's Hangout Event)
3.content: Chongyun met the Traveler at the Liyue Harbor wharf while chasing rumors. They sorted Xingqiu's clues at Wanwen Bookhouse, mostly nonsense such as a demon made from a popsicle, and followed leads to Wuwang Hill's Test of Courage, a staged scare attraction for couples. Depending on choices the outing ends in different ways: odd smoke and hilichurls he counts as progress; a day spent making popsicles and cold noodles for a poor brother and sister at Chihu Rock, who love him; a spicy-popsicle meltdown; or the discovery that the "ghosts" are staff in costume.

4.content: Shenhe, a disciple of the adeptus Cloud Retainer raised in the mountains, turned out to be a long-lost relative of Chongyun's clan, from a branch family destroyed by tragedy. The elders were overjoyed to hear she was alive, prepared gifts and chose an auspicious day for a reunion, but she is very hard to find. Chongyun realizes with dismay that the family tree makes her his aunt. Shenhe finds it hard to believe she still has living relatives and is willing to help his training, but only if he meets her alone in the mountains, because the family is too sociable for her to refuse politely. He has called her an adept exorcist.

5.comment: Chongyun: Xiao, the Conqueror of Demons
5.content: Chongyun reveres Xiao, the yaksha who has fought evil beside Liyue's exorcists for generations, openly and in secret. It stings that Xiao calls exorcists' repertoire lacking and their power trivial, and Chongyun wants him to understand their importance. Reviewing rumors, he recognizes a masked figure with a polearm at Guili Plains as the Vigilant Yaksha and says he is not an enemy.

6.content: Xiangling sees Chongyun "dragged" to Wanmin Restaurant by Xingqiu, who apologizes as each hot dish arrives and eats it while Chongyun watches. Chongyun refuses her spicy food, claiming personal preference and Mushroom Slime Stew. The real reason is the clan party where a chili-stuffed rice ball made him chase her with a charm and sword. He paid for the damage and carved her a talisman, and she was not upset at all. Chef Mao makes his popsicles.
